# Maelys CLI reference

Common contract: `agent-cli/v2`. For the machine-readable detail run
`PROGRAM describe COMMAND_ID --format json`.

## `maelys-release` (Maelys Release)

| Identifier | Usage | Effect | Output | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| help | `help [COMMAND_ID] \| --help` | read | json-envelope | Show the help of the program or of one command. |
| version | `version \| --version` | read | json-envelope | Show the product, program, version and contract. |
| describe | `describe [COMMAND_ID] [--summary] [--prefix PREFIX]` | read | json-envelope | Show the machine-readable catalog, or one descriptor. |
| completion | `completion SHELL` | read | json-envelope | Print the shell completion script generated from the catalog. |
| complete.candidates | `__complete [WORDS...]` | read | json-records | Completion candidates for the words given after --. |
| migrate | `migrate DIR [--product NAME] [--documents FILE] [--documents-repository REPOSITORY] [--push] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Move a product's prose into the documentation repository with its history and out of the product; plan without --apply. |
| new | `new DIR [--product NAME] [--mechanism MECHANISM] [--depends DEPENDENCY] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Create a Maelys repository in an empty directory: licence, version, changelog, pins, and the files of the socle; plan without --apply. |
| adopt | `adopt DIR [--product NAME] [--mechanism MECHANISM] [--allow-untagged] [--allow-lock] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Write the conventions of the socle into a product, and its release files when it publishes through the socle; plan without --apply. |
| check | `check DIR [--product NAME] [--mechanism MECHANISM] [--docs-contract]` | read | json-envelope | Report the conventions of a product and, when it publishes through the socle, its release mechanism; exit 2 on any violation. |
| declarations | `declarations DIR [--product NAME]` | read | json-envelope | Return the product contract as data: pinned dependencies, packages, formulas; exit 2 when invalid. |
| preflight | `preflight DIR [--product NAME] [--docs-contract]` | read | json-envelope | Check, then report what the release workflow would refuse of the next tag; exit 2 when not ready. It reads the configuration and the publication record, and builds nothing itself. |
| signers | `signers DIR [--add FILE] [--principal NAME] [--retire WHO] [--at TIME] [--apply]` | execute | json-envelope | List the keys that may sign a release of this fleet, or prepare one line of that file; --apply writes it. |
| cut | `cut DIR VERSION [--product NAME] [--mechanism MECHANISM] [--tag] [--message FILE] [--timeout MINUTES] [--apply]` | preview then commit with --apply | json-envelope | Open the release of a version, then sign its tag on the merge commit whose checks passed; plan without --apply. |
| dependencies | `dependencies DIR [--product NAME] [--directory DIR] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Materialise the product's pinned dependencies at their commits in one directory apart from any working copy, refreshing what is already there; plan without --apply. |
| protect | `protect DIR [--apply] [--allow-lock] [--allow-narrow] [--without-legs]` | execute | json-envelope | Report what the default branch should require, derived from the workflows and the runs it carries rather than typed by hand; --apply writes it. |
| rehearse | `rehearse DIR [TARGET] [--product NAME] [--image IMAGE] [--package-command COMMAND] [--check] [--check-command COMMAND] [--keep] [--channel NAME] [--tag TAG]` | execute | json-envelope | Replay the Linux build job of the release in a Docker container on a copy of the working tree, make check with --check, or a channel's publish script against a published release with --channel. |
| render | `render TEMPLATE OUTPUT [KEY=VALUE...]` | execute | json-envelope | Replace @KEY@ placeholders of a template, refusing to leave one unrendered. |
| tap | `tap PRODUCT TAG FORMULA [--skip-style] [--apply]` | preview then commit with --apply | json-envelope | Publish a rendered formula into the Homebrew tap with a signed commit; plan without --apply. |
| self-test | `self-test [--verbose]` | execute | json-envelope | Run the socle's own tests. |
| vendor | `vendor` | execute | json-envelope | Refresh bin/maelys_cli.py from maelys-cli at dependencies/maelys-cli.pin and record its digest. |

Global options:

- `--format text|json|jsonl`: Select text for humans, json for one envelope or jsonl for records.
- `--json`: Exact alias of --format json.
- `--compact`: Render JSON on a single line.
- `--pretty`: --pretty=false selects compact JSON.
- `--non-interactive`: Never prompt; fail instead of asking a question.
- `--color auto|always|never`: Control ANSI colors on terminals.
- `--progress auto|always|never`: Show the progress of a long run on stderr in text mode: auto only when stderr is a terminal.
- `--verbose`: Add the details of the run on stderr in text mode; silent in JSON.
- `--pager auto|always|never`: Page the text rendering when stdout is a terminal; never in a pipe, in JSON or under --non-interactive.
- `--field NAME`: Render one top-level member of data instead of the whole result, by the text or jsonl rendering rules.
- `--help`: Show the help of the selected command.
